intro: The food that arrived is not what you ordered. Explain politely.

conversation.speaker: waiter
conversation.text: Here is your food. Please enjoy your meal.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Politely say this is not what you ordered.
expected: Excuse me, this is not what I ordered.
Sorry, I think this is not my order.
Excuse me, I did not order this.
conversation.hint: Try: "Excuse me, this is not what I ordered."

conversation.speaker: waiter
conversation.text: Oh! I am very sorry. What did you order?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: My order was rice and dal.

conversation.speaker: waiter
conversation.text: Let me check with the kitchen. It will take ten minutes.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask whether it can be done faster, politely.
expected: Could you make it a little faster, please?
Is it possible to be quicker?
conversation.hint: Try: "Could you make it a little faster, please?"

conversation.speaker: waiter
conversation.text: I will ask the cook to hurry. Would you like some water while you wait?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Yes, some water would be nice.
That would be very kind, thank you.

conversation.speaker: waiter
conversation.text: Here is your correct order. Again, I am sorry for the mistake.

conversation.prompt: Say it is fine and thank him.
expected: No problem, thank you for fixing it.
